analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 55.1 to 64.9, exiting oversold territory, and MACD histogram improved from 2.5276 to 2.2555, signaling bottoming. The 5-day low ($319.02) is higher than the 20-day low ($291.94), forming a Higher Low pattern and suggesting recovery potential. Volume is at a normal 1.16x the 5-day average. Trading above the SMA200 ($354.83) maintains the bullish trend.
